solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: One supporting cuts met with knight

parts.note: saw is a past tense meaning met or encountered, as in 'I saw her yesterday'
in chess the knight is the piece shaped like a horse

explanation.surface: A clue about a knight's supporter at a joust who also met the blows.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cuts' reads like wounds or sword strokes; here it means the wood being sawn.
explanation.definitionFit: A sawhorse is a trestle frame that holds timber steady while a carpenter saws through it.

clue.text: Famed Assyrian house is home to sheep

indicators.note: is home to means houses or contains, so the sheep goes inside

parts.note: a semi is a semi-detached house, half of a pair joined by a shared wall
a ram is a male sheep

explanation.surface: A famous Assyrian house where sheep are kept.
explanation.walkthrough: A semi is a common British house type, one of two sharing a wall.
explanation.definitionFit: Semiramis was a legendary queen of Assyria, famed for founding Babylon and its gardens.

clue.text: Charge bundle to keep bird on ground

indicators.note: to keep means to hold in, so the bundle holds the bird

parts.note: a wad is a bundle, as of banknotes
the rhea is a flightless South American bird, so it stays on the ground

explanation.surface: Someone charged a bundle to keep a bird grounded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Charge' looks like a fee, given 'bundle'; it is an explosive charge.
explanation.definitionFit: A warhead is the explosive charge carried at the front of a missile or torpedo.

clue.text: Cricket side's method hardly secret?

parts.note: the on side is the leg side of a cricket pitch; the 's adds an S
how means the method or way, as in 'the how of it'

explanation.surface: A cricket team whose tactics are hardly secret.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the on side is the half of the field behind the batter's legs.
explanation.definitionFit: Something on show is on public display, the very opposite of being kept hidden.

clue.text: Pen pusher, perhaps, bursting into tears

indicators.note: bursting means breaking apart, so the letters of the words are rearranged

explanation.surface: An office clerk, perhaps, bursting into tears.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pen pusher' reads as a clerk; here it is someone who pushes pens, that is, sells them.
explanation.definitionFit: A stationer sells pens and paper, so promotes or pushes pens to buyers: a punning description.

clue.text: Ready to assimilate City formula

indicators.note: to assimilate is to take in, so the word for ready absorbs the City's letters

parts.note: ripe fruit is ready to be eaten
EC is the postcode area of the City of London, so it stands for the City

explanation.surface: A City firm ready to adopt some new financial formula.
explanation.walkthrough: EC is the postal district of the City of London, the financial square mile.
explanation.definitionFit: A recipe is a set formula, whether for a dish or, figuratively, for success or disaster.

clue.text: Lock phone on rental contract

indicators.note: in a down answer on means placed above, so the phone word comes first

parts.note: to ring someone is to phone them
a let is a lease or rental arrangement

explanation.surface: A tenant phoning about a lock on a rental property.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lock' suggests a door; it is a lock of hair.
explanation.definitionFit: A ringlet is a curled lock of hair, a single coiled tress.

clue.text: Using colour, 20 to dress person travelling on time

indicators.note: to dress means to clothe, so the stylish word wraps round the rest

parts.note: the answer to 20 across, a word meaning stylish

indicators.note: in a down answer on means the traveller sits above the time letter

parts.note: the Roma are a traditionally travelling people

explanation.surface: A stylish traveller dressing in colourful clothes and arriving on time.
explanation.walkthrough: '20' points to the answer to 20 across.
explanation.definitionFit: Chromatic means relating to or using colour, from the Greek word for colour.

clue.text: Fake groom died, having introduced tango

indicators.note: having introduced means letting something in, so the tango letter goes inside

parts.note: to preen is to groom oneself
Tango is the NATO phonetic alphabet word for T
D is the abbreviation for died, used in dates

explanation.surface: A bridegroom dies after dancing the tango, or only seems to.
explanation.walkthrough: 'groom' reads as a bridegroom but is the verb preen.
explanation.definitionFit: To fake something is to pretend it, putting on a false show.

clue.text: Wreck in sea on moon finally eclipsed

indicators.note: the final letter is blotted out, as the moon is in an eclipse, so it goes

parts.note: a mare is one of the dark plains on the moon once taken for seas

explanation.surface: A shipwreck lying in a sea under the moon during an eclipse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'finally eclipsed' removes the last letter, E, from MARE.
explanation.definitionFit: To mar something is to spoil or ruin it, the verb sense of wreck.

clue.text: Crook to entertain sister's subordinate

parts.note: a shepherd's crook is a kind of staff
to nurse a hope or grudge is to entertain it

explanation.surface: A crooked figure plans to entertain a sister's junior colleague.
explanation.walkthrough: In British hospitals a sister is the senior nurse in charge of a ward.
explanation.definitionFit: In UK hospitals a staff nurse ranks just below the ward sister, so works under her.

clue.text: Right-hand man keeping to hyperbole

indicators.note: keeping means holding inside, so the man's name holds the word to

parts.note: Eric is a man's name

explanation.surface: A right-hand man prone to exaggeration.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Right-hand man' reads as a trusted deputy, but the phrase is split in two and 'keeping' works on the man.
explanation.definitionFit: Rhetoric in its loose sense is inflated, showy language, and hyperbole is exaggerated overstatement.

clue.text: Tradesman, powerless to deliver cut wood

indicators.note: P is the physics symbol for power, so being without power drops that letter

parts.note: a plumber is a skilled tradesman

explanation.surface: A tradesman whose power tools have failed delivers sawn timber.
explanation.definitionFit: Lumber is timber sawn into planks, especially in North American usage.

clue.text: Current in which HM ships lost way

indicators.note: lost means the ships are gone from the word for current

parts.note: modern means current or up to date
Her Majesty's ships make up the Royal Navy, abbreviated RN

explanation.surface: A sea current in which naval ships lost their way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Current' looks like a flow of water but is an adjective meaning up to date.
explanation.definitionFit: A mode is a manner or method of doing something, a synonym of way.

clue.text: Clear river containing single rodent

indicators.note: containing means holding inside, so the river surrounds the other pieces

parts.note: the Exe is a river in Devon, south-west England
single means one
a rat is a rodent

explanation.surface: A river cleared of a single rodent.
explanation.definitionFit: To exonerate is to clear someone of blame or a charge.

clue.text: Pressure in tie — United beaten for lack of fitness?

indicators.note: in says the pressure letter sits inside the rearranged letters
beaten means knocked out of shape, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

parts.note: P is the physics symbol for pressure

explanation.surface: Under pressure in a cup tie, a beaten United side shows its lack of fitness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beaten' rearranges the two words into INETITUDE, and 'in' then places the pressure letter inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Ineptitude is being unfit for a task, a lack of fitness in the sense of suitability, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Testing time for one at crease, one performing

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of
in cricket the batter stands at the crease, so a bat is one there
I is the Roman numeral for one
on means performing, as an actor on stage

explanation.surface: A tense time for a cricketer at the crease, putting on a performance.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the crease is the line where the batter stands.
explanation.definitionFit: Probation is a trial period in which a new employee or offender is tested.

clue.text: One charming Chinese detective in lodge

indicators.note: in places the detective inside the word for lodge

parts.note: to lodge a complaint is to enter it formally
Charlie Chan is the fictional Chinese-American detective of novels and films

explanation.surface: A charming Chinese detective staying at a lodge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lodge' reads as a house; it is the verb, as in lodging a claim.
explanation.definitionFit: An enchanter casts spells, charming people in the old magical sense of that word.

clue.text: Tough Berber reflective in secure place

parts.note: strong means tough or sturdy

indicators.note: reflective suggests a mirror image, so the word for a Berber is read backwards

parts.note: the Moors were North African peoples including Berbers

explanation.surface: A tough, thoughtful Berber in some secure hideout.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reflective' reads as thoughtful but turns MOOR into ROOM.
explanation.definitionFit: A strongroom is a fortified, locked room for keeping valuables safe.

clue.text: Cereal stirred below temperature becoming syrup

indicators.note: in a down answer below means the stirred letters come after the temperature letter
stirred means mixed about, so the letters of the word are rearranged

explanation.surface: Breakfast cereal stirred at low temperature turning syrupy.
explanation.definitionFit: Treacle is a thick dark syrup made in refining sugar, the British name for molasses.

clue.text: Unprincipled little man enters gallery

indicators.note: enters means goes into, so the name goes inside the gallery word

parts.note: the gods is the highest gallery in a theatre
Les is a short form of the man's name Leslie

explanation.surface: An unscrupulous little man sneaks into an art gallery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gallery' suggests art; it is the gods, the theatre's top tier.
explanation.definitionFit: Godless means wicked or without morals, lacking principles as well as faith.

clue.text: Stylish welcome received in clubs twice

indicators.note: received in means taken inside, so the greeting goes between the two letters
twice means the letter for clubs appears two times

parts.note: C is the card-game abbreviation for clubs
hi is a word of welcome or greeting

explanation.surface: A stylish welcome given at two nightclubs.
explanation.definitionFit: Chic describes someone elegantly fashionable, a close synonym of stylish.

clue.text: Process of reduction in capital growth

definitions.text: Process of reduction in capital growth

parts.words: Process of reduction in capital growth
parts.note: capital means head, so a cutting back of what grows on the head; also a finance term for a cut in an asset's value

explanation.surface: A financial term for shrinking the growth of capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' reads as money but also means the head; the growth there is hair.
explanation.definitionFit: Trimming hair cuts back the growth on the head, and in finance the same word means a write-down of value.

clue.text: Brie munched by me in galley

indicators.note: by means beside, so the word me is placed next to the rearranged cheese
munched means chewed up, so the letters of the cheese are rearranged

explanation.surface: Brie eaten by me in the ship's kitchen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'galley' suggests a ship's kitchen; it is an ancient oared ship.
explanation.definitionFit: A bireme is an ancient warship rowed with two banks of oars, a type of galley.

clue.text: Small deposit to finish in bank

parts.note: DEP is a short form of deposit, so small signals the abbreviation
end means finish

explanation.surface: Putting a small deposit into the bank to finish things off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bank' looks like the place for the deposit; it is a verb, as in banking on someone.
explanation.definitionFit: To bank on someone is to rely on or count on them, as to depend on them.

clue.text: Fundamental article about the Italian church

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the first pieces go round the Italian word

parts.note: basic means fundamental
il is the Italian word for the
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A basic article on an Italian church.
explanation.definitionFit: A basilica is a large oblong church, especially one given special privileges by the Pope.

clue.text: Feline woman binding husband in chains

definitions.note: plural in the clue, but the answer names a single set of chains

indicators.note: binding means wrapping round, so the cat holds the husband letter

parts.note: a cat is a feline
H is the abbreviation for husband in family trees
Elaine is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A catlike woman ties up her husband in chains.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Feline woman' reads as one catlike person but is two separate pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A chatelaine was a clasp at a housekeeper's waist with short chains for keys and scissors.

clue.text: Alcoholic in the end put back to bed

indicators.note: in the end points to the final letter of the word alcoholic
put back means turned round, so the word to is read in reverse

explanation.surface: A drunk who in the end was put back to bed.
explanation.definitionFit: A cot is a small bed, a baby's barred bed in Britain or a camp bed in America.

clue.text: About to introduce tax break

parts.note: re means about or concerning, as in letter headings
a cess is an old word for a tax or levy

explanation.surface: A government about to bring in a tax break.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tax break' reads as one phrase; 'break' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A recess is a break or pause in proceedings, as when Parliament or a court adjourns.

clue.text: Forebear requires an exotic escort

indicators.note: exotic means strange or foreign, so the letters of escort are rearranged

explanation.surface: A forebear insists on an exotic escort.
explanation.definitionFit: A forebear is a forefather, someone from whom one is descended.
